# HOUSE DNA — drums enter gradually

# First 4 bars: piano alone.
rest(15.5)

# Next 4 bars: quiet hats between the beats.
for bar in range(4):
    for beat in range(4):
        rest(0.5)
        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=45) 
        # Finish the 8-bar intro.
rest(0.5)
# After the intro: 4 bars of kick and hats.
for bar in range(4):
    for beat in range(4):
        playNote(0, beats=0.5, velocity=90)
        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=50)
# Bars 13–16: kick, hats and clap together.
for bar in range(4):
    for beat in range(4):

        # Add the clap to beats 2 and 4.
        # Python counts beats from 0.
        if beat == 1 or beat == 3:
            playNote([0, 10], beats=0.5, velocity=85)
        else:
            playNote(0, beats=0.5, velocity=90)

        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=50)
# Bars 17–18: kick and quiet hats, no clap.
for bar in range(2):
    for beat in range(4):
        playNote(0, beats=0.5, velocity=85)
        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=40)

# Bar 19: hats alone.
for beat in range(4):
    rest(0.5)
    playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=35)

# Bar 20: let the piano take over.
rest(4)
# Bars 21–28: drums return for an 8-bar drop.
for bar in range(8):
    for beat in range(4):

        # Kick and clap together on beats 2 and 4.
        if beat == 1 or beat == 3:
            playNote([0, 10], beats=0.5, velocity=85)
        else:
            playNote(0, beats=0.5, velocity=95)

        # Hats between the kicks.
        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=50)
# Leave space during the bridge.
moveTo(112)
rest(32)
# Bars 37–40: hats gradually return after the bridge.
moveTo(144)

for strength in [35, 45, 55]:
    for beat in range(4):
        rest(0.5)
        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=strength)

# Last bar: three hats, then a beat of space.
for beat in range(3):
    rest(0.5)
    playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=55)

rest(1)
# HOUSE DNA — first 4 bars of the main drop
moveTo(160)

# Strong kick on every beat.
for beat in range(16):
    playNote(0, beats=1, velocity=105)

# Offbeat hats with alternating strengths.
moveTo(160)

for beat in range(16):
    rest(0.5)
    strength = 60 if beat % 2 == 0 else 45
    playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=strength)

# A restrained clap on beats 2 and 4.
moveTo(160)

for bar in range(4):
    rest(1)
    playNote(10, beats=1, velocity=65)
    rest(1)
    playNote(10, beats=1, velocity=65)
# HOUSE DNA — percussion develops through the bridge
moveTo(112)

# First 4 bridge bars: a quiet shaker with uneven accents.
for bar in range(4):
    for strength in [40, 22, 30, 24, 45, 22, 32, 24]:
        playNote(11, beats=0.5, velocity=strength)

# Last 4 bridge bars: add kick and hats.
moveTo(128)

for bar in range(4):
    for beat in range(4):
        playNote(0, beats=0.5, velocity=75)
        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=45)

# Layer the shaker underneath those drums.
moveTo(128)

for bar in range(4):
    for strength in [45, 25, 35, 25, 50, 25, 35, 30]:
        playNote(11, beats=0.5, velocity=strength)

# Return to the end of our current 44-bar arrangement.
moveTo(176)
# HOUSE DNA — develop the drop for 8 more bars
moveTo(176)

for bar in range(8):
    start = getPlayhead()

    # Every fourth bar: leave the final beat empty.
    # This makes a small break in the groove.
    kick_count = 3 if bar % 4 == 3 else 4

    for beat in range(kick_count):
        playNote(0, beats=1, velocity=110)

    # Hats alternate in strength.
    moveTo(start)
    for beat in range(kick_count):
        rest(0.5)
        strength = 60 if beat % 2 == 0 else 45
        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=strength)

    # Clap on beat 2.
    moveTo(start + 1)
    playNote(10, beats=0.25, velocity=80)

    # Clap on beat 4, except during the phrase break.
    if kick_count == 4:
        moveTo(start + 3)
        playNote(10, beats=0.25, velocity=75)

    # Shaker gives movement underneath the main beat.
    moveTo(start)
    for strength in [40, 20, 30, 25, 45, 20]:
        playNote(11, beats=0.5, velocity=strength)

    # Complete the bar.
    moveTo(start + 4)
# Give the transition a stronger kick pulse.
moveTo(144)

for beat in range(15):
    playNote(0, beats=1, velocity=95)

# Leave one beat clear before the drop.
rest(1)

# Return to the end of the current arrangement.
moveTo(208)
# FINAL BUILD — hats get faster.
moveTo(208)

# First bar: half-beat hats.
for hit in range(8):
    playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=55)

# Second bar: quarter-beat hats.
for hit in range(16):
    playNote(4, beats=0.25, velocity=60)

# Third bar: alternate accents on fast hats.
for hit in range(16):
    strength = 70 if hit % 2 == 0 else 45
    playNote(4, beats=0.25, velocity=strength)

# Fourth bar: very fast hats, then silence.
for hit in range(24):
    strength = 55 + hit
    playNote(4, beats=0.125, velocity=strength)

rest(1)

# FINAL DROP — four bars of kick, clap and hats.
for bar in range(4):
    for beat in range(4):
        if beat == 1 or beat == 3:
            playNote([0, 10], beats=0.5, velocity=100)
        else:
            playNote(0, beats=0.5, velocity=115)

        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=60)

# OUTRO — two bars of kick and hats.
for bar in range(2):
    for beat in range(4):
        playNote(0, beats=0.5, velocity=90)
        playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=40)

# One bar of hats alone.
for beat in range(4):
    rest(0.5)
    playNote(4, beats=0.5, velocity=30)

# One final kick, then let the music settle.
playNote(0, beats=1, velocity=95)
rest(3)

    for note in [45, 41, 40, 43]:
        playNote([note, note + 12],
                 beats=1, velocity=65, sustain=1)
        rest(3)
# HOUSE DNA — developing 8-bar bridge

# First half: spacious chords, with changing inner notes.
playNote([45, 60, 64, 71], beats=4, velocity=40)
playNote([45, 59, 64, 69], beats=4, velocity=35)

]:

playNote(60, beats=0.5, velocity=35)

playNote(64, beats=1.5, velocity=45)

playNote(67, beats=1.5, velocity=50)
playNote(66, beats=0.5, velocity=35)

# Bars 35–36: a higher answer, then room to breathe.

playNote(62, beats=0.5, velocity=55)
playNote(71, beats=1, velocity=55)

rest(0.5)
playNote(69, beats=0.5, velocity=45)
playNote(67, beats=1, velocity=40)
playNote(62, beats=1, velocity=35)
rest(1)  # End of your bridge

# HOUSE DNA — transition with movement throughout

# HOUSE DNA — transition with movement throughout
moveTo(144)

# Four changing chords, one per bar.
transition_chords = [
    [53, 57, 60],  # F major
    [55, 59, 62],  # G major
    [57, 60, 64],  # A minor
    [55, 59, 62]   # G major
]

for index, chord in enumerate(transition_chords):

    # Chord pulses become stronger as the drop approaches.
    strength = 55 + index * 5

    playNote(chord, beats=1, velocity=strength, sustain=0.5)
    rest(0.5)
    playNote(chord, beats=0.5,
             velocity=strength - 10, sustain=0.5)
    playNote(chord, beats=1.5,
             velocity=strength, sustain=0.25)
    rest(0.5)

# A rising phrase above the chords.
moveTo(144)

phrases = [
    [60, 64, 65],
    [62, 64, 67],
    [64, 67, 69],
    [67, 69, 71]
]

for phrase in phrases:
    rest(0.5)
    playNote(phrase[0], beats=1, velocity=45)
    playNote(phrase[1], beats=0.5, velocity=40)
    rest(0.5)
    playNote(phrase[2], beats=1, velocity=55)
    rest(0.5)


# Main drop: fewer piano hits leave room for the groove.
moveTo(160)

for chord in chords:

    # One strong chord at the start of the bar.
    playNote(chord, beats=0.75, velocity=70, sustain=0.5)
    rest(1.75)

    # A quieter answer between the kicks.
    playNote(chord, beats=0.5, velocity=50, sustain=0.5)
    rest(1)
# New drop rhythm: short answers and longer accents.
moveTo(176)

for repeat in range(2):
    for index, chord in enumerate(chords):

        playNote(chord, beats=0.75,
                 velocity=75, sustain=0.5)
        rest(0.75)

        playNote(chord, beats=0.25,
                 velocity=50, sustain=0.25)
        rest(0.75)

        playNote(chord, beats=0.5,
                 velocity=65, sustain=0.5)

        if index == 3:
            # A quick descending answer fills the drum break.
            playNote(67, beats=0.25, velocity=50)
            playNote(62, beats=0.25, velocity=40)
            playNote(59, beats=0.5, velocity=45)
        else:
            rest(1)
# Let the bass and fast hats lead the build.

rest(16)

# FINAL DROP — just two chord accents per bar.
for chord in chords:
    playNote(chord, beats=0.75, velocity=65, sustain=0.5)
    rest(1.75)

    playNote(chord, beats=0.5, velocity=50, sustain=0.5)
    rest(1)

# OUTRO — a short progression resolves to A minor.
playNote([53, 57, 60], beats=4, velocity=35)
playNote([55, 59, 62], beats=4, velocity=30)
playNote([57, 60, 64], beats=4, velocity=30)

# Final chord rings over the last kick.
playNote([45, 57, 60, 64], beats=4, velocity=35)
